$comment: Trusted sources for skills, plugins, MCP servers and GitHub Actions. Explained in docs/SKILLS.md. commit = the commit reviewed on the reviewed date. vendored = the skill folders copied byte for byte from that commit into vendorDir, with the sha256 of every file; npm run check:skills verifies them. For GitHub Actions, workflows pin release.commit (the newest release tag) by full SHA.

statuses.approved: Agents may use it, at the pinned commit
statuses.approved-with-limits: Agents may use it within the limits in notes
statuses.pending-review: Not used until the owner records a review and a yes in docs/SKILLS.md
statuses.optional-paid: Needs a paid plan or API; off unless the owner decides otherwise
